question.problem: Estimate the area under the curve $y=4-2x$ over the interval $[0,1]$ using a right Riemann sum with step size $Δx=0.25.$
question.worked_solution:
Let's sketch our situation.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14222967/assets/c478dd4988aaf23348c2453e1f9fca137ddd33284cde7cb7eae1775982bd4b2e.png)

The area $A$ under the graph can be approximated using the formula

$$
A≈(\overset{\text{heights}}{\overset{⏞}{f(0.25)+f(0.5)+f(0.75)+f(1)}})\cdot {{Δx}_{⏟}}_{\text{width}}.
$$

So, we now set up a table with the values of $f(x)$ at each point:

| $x$ | $0.25$ | $0.5$ | $0.75$ | $1$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $f(x)$ | $3.5$ | $3$ | $2.5$ | $2$ |

Finally, we obtain the following approximation for our area:

$$
\begin{aligned}A & ≈(3.5+3+2.5+2)\cdot 0.25 \\  & =11\cdot 0.25 \\  & =2.75\end{aligned}
$$
